description: Cancel (withdraw) an order — only the requester can cancel their OWN order, and only while it is still open (once fulfillment started, coordinate via the app instead). Releases any reserved stock.
name: cancel_order

closedAtIso.description: The same moment as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp — read THIS one; the server does no timezone conversion

webUrl.description: Link to this order in the web app — give your user THIS, never the raw `orderId` (that is a machine handle for your next call). Absent when the deployment has no public address

title: Cancel order
